name: io.github.nyingimaina/tinkerdeck
title: Tinkerdeck
description: Start, stop and watch a project's local dev terminals (servers, databases, shells), run one-off commands and use git, with cheap plain-text output. Windows desktop app plus the tdk command line.

_meta.install: Run the installer (it adds tdk to PATH and can register the server with detected LLM tools), then `tdk mcp install`.
